name: Before/After Proof Panel
description: A truthful temporal comparison of one subject's baseline and credible observed outcome.
composition_guidance: Show the same subject across a clear left-to-right temporal seam: a truthful baseline on the left and a credible observed outcome on the right. Reserve one uncluttered upper title band for the complete intended episode title rendered directly by the selected image model. The active Visual Style remains the final authority for medium, palette, texture, lighting, and rendering technique.
composition_rules: Use the same subject in matched temporal states.
Make the left baseline and right observed outcome equally legible.
Keep one upper title band clear of the comparison seam and subject detail.
Show sequence without asserting that the change caused the outcome.
required_elements: One subject shown in matched baseline and observed-outcome states
One upper title band with the model-rendered complete episode title
avoid_elements: Fabricated labels, measurements, causality, or transformation claims
Different subjects presented as a before/after pair
Copied trade dress, logos, watermarks, or post-render typography compositing
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended episode title directly in the upper title band. Use one, two, or three balanced lines according to title length, preserving high contrast and small-screen readability.
visual_style_guidance: The recipe controls only the matched temporal comparison, upper title band, and truthful baseline/outcome reading order. The active Visual Style remains authoritative for all rendering choices.
